rows.label: qst200222_msg0001
rows.name:
Harhal, what are you doing here?
Won't you tell me everything?

rows.label: qst200222_msg0002
rows.name:
You're not the kind of person
who'd do this.

rows.label: qst200222_msg0003
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Those eyes of yours...
They're just like Dad's.

rows.label: qst200222_msg0005
rows.name:
Using Pollen Orbs as ingredients,
I'm making an even more powerful
Fraudrinco.

rows.label: qst200222_msg0007
rows.name:
Nopon mostly eat Pollen Orbs, right?
Boost the effect, make a drink,
and people get hooked too.

rows.label: qst200222_msg0010
rows.name:
What's wrong, Harhal? Won't
you tell us the rest?

rows.label: qst200222_msg0011
rows.name:
No. I can't tell you any more[ML:Dash ]
Just go.

rows.label: qst200222_msg0012
rows.name: Sorry, but I have nothing more to say.
